review_description: Really helpful and thorough during the sales processInstallers were great, very clean and tidy jobCustomer service was very good and responsiveOnly negatives were:The originally designed panel layout would not actually fit, so had to drop the size from 25 to 24 panelsRepeatedly told they would be arriving between 7am & 8am on the day, in reality they didnt arrive until 9am and to be fair to the crew they had to travel ~2 hours to get here, suspect they default to 7-8 and dont actually factor in additional travelThey also issued the final invoice in the morning of they install day, before the panel change as mentioned above, would be bettered served issuing the invoice towards the end of the install not at the start of the day

Jordie, the sales guy was patient, polite and professional with all my questions and offered what looks like a quality system.  I cannot comment yet on the quality or performance because it won’t be installed for another few months!

PSC were very helpful, and were answer our questions. Unfortunately due to high demand we were unable to qualify for 2025 rebates and ended up with the lesser 2026 rebates as our system is not due for install until jan 2026.But they were able to trim the total price to a figure that was competitive with other installers.
Great communication, even when we were absent from the property.Installers polite, helpful.

After service from Penrith Solar has been great, although I had to raise problems I thought they should have picked up, installation was quick and professional with a full team of three trucks, clean up was tidy and complete with 2 roof tiles replaced, monitoring is left to yourself, educate yourself as you may need to raise tinkering issues with installer’s later, return from company is very quick and prompt,I would use this installer again.

Easy to understand. Installed panels before NSW battery subsidy came in and then installed battery after. This allowed Energy Australia smart meter to be installed between the two dates. Install team were a real delight. Broke two tiles but I had 14 clean ones ready to go so no problem. I was impressed that so much hard work went into the installation with so little damage. Very good crew installed 25 panels in 4 hours while power board being amended. System tested well, instruction given on isolating panels from power board, and away they went. Smart metre was organised through Penrith Solar Centre worked as advertised. When battery installed instruction given on isolating and basic operation. Very good discussion of how to get best use from battery in our household.

I chose PSC from the three companies referred by Solarquotes as they were the more proactive and the installation team were all in-house (no subcontractors). The original quote was before the NSW government battery subsidy was discontinued, PSC did give me a discount on the updated price, which was unexpected but much appreciated.The installation team arrived on the day and time specified, I was expecting to have some conduits running up walls but all wiring was concealed leaving a very neat installation.17 X 500 W panels ( 8.5 KW ) 24KWH battery.

They attended my premises in May 2025 and gave a quote that was accepted, and the entire amount was paid in full. They installed the battery prior to the 1 July rebate date. They made an appointment to attend my property on 1 July to commission the battery.When I hadn't heard from them, I contacted their office and was told that they had been made promises by Chris Bowen regarding the rebates and based their quotes on those promises only to have those promises reneged and they now faced losing over 1.5 million on batteries they had already installed.They then asked if I could pay more money towards my battery to help them stay afloat so they would be around to offer warranty and aftersales service etc. I offered to pay an additional $1000, and I transferred the money to them that day and they attended my premises and commissioned the battery.I now see them posting photos of Chris Bowen visiting their business and lavishing praise on the man that allegedly almost cost them 1.5 million and possibly their business. If they had any decency left, they would refund the addition money I gave them as they clearly lied about Chris Bowen.The installers did a good job and were polite, on time and professional. The product supplied is good quality and I have no issues with the battery.I have attempted to contact them via email and their Facebook page several times and they have never responded to any of my enquiries. I did comment on their recent post regarding the visit of Chris Bowen to their business and my comment was deleted and I was blocked. Not what I would consider a professional attitude towards a customer who not only paid in full but then gave extra money to help you out.

From the very beginning, PSC made the whole process smooth and stress-free. The team was on time, professional, and took the time to explain everything clearly. They recommended and supplied a 13 kW AIKO solar panel array paired with the Sigenergy SigenStor 10 kW inverter and 24 kWh battery system, which has been a perfect fit for our needs.The installation was completed to a very high standard — the crew worked efficiently, respected our home, and cleaned up thoroughly afterwards. It was obvious they take pride in their work. Since commissioning, the system has been running flawlessly. The backup feature kicked in seamlessly during a recent outage, keeping our home powered without interruption.I’ve also been impressed that the system’s solar output has closely matched the Solcast production estimates, which gives me confidence in both the system design and its long-term performance.I couldn’t be happier with both the gear and the service. I’d happily recommend PSC to anyone considering solar and battery — they really know their stuff and deliver on their promises.
System has not yet been installed, but all our dealings have been positive, from quote options to explanation of the system. They also arranged for an electrician to update our meter box.

We had Sam and Ryan from PSCenergy to install the sigenergy battieries!Both of them were fantastic installing the whole system.They explained the next steps and how the system works!I would recommend  this team for your battery installation.

Very helpful with deciding on components and placement. Happy to answer all questions, no hard sell.Installation completed in one day as quoted. The system was working & I'd been helped to set up the app before they left.Everything left neat & tidy.

We are in the process of installing a Sigenergy solar solar system from PSC Energy. Unfortunately the completion of the installation has been delayed by a shortage of Sigenergy batteries. It was hard to choose between the 3 suppliers recommended by Solar Quotes - we could have gone with any of them, but in the end PSC was just a little cheaper. We can’t give a final opinion until the full system is commissioned, but their performance so far in installing the roof panels has been impressive.

About three years ago, I had solar panels installed, and the system has been working perfectly without any issues. Due to the weather, the installation took place over two days, and the overall result was quite good. However, there were a few disappointing details. For example, the cables were not secured to the floor of the roof-ceiling cavity but were left loosely laid out (though I’m not sure if this is electrically acceptable). Also, a roof pipe was cut short, but the top part wasn’t replaced with a proper fitting, which was a letdown. Additionally, after the ladder was removed, tree branches have been accumulating in the area where the ladder had been placed—this seems to be due to the gutter not being properly restored afterward. I wish these small issues had been explained or addressed, as they make a difference in the overall quality.

PSC installed my 9.5kWh Enphase and Trina system in November 2023. Love the Enphase microconverters on each panel; great for efficiency. From start to finish, the process was entirely without any problems. Staff were very kind and very helpful throughout.My tiled roof is now 106 years old and probably quite brittle. I got 30 extra second-hand tiles for free from local FB page, just in case. The installers only used about 5 of the extra tiles. The care taken with my installation by PSC is evident from the fact I have had NO LEAKS (even after so much rain!), or other problems for that matter, in the time since.Much appreciated, as I was really quite worried about my roof.In late May 2025, I had PSC install a huge 24kWh Synergy battery, with 3-phase backup. Installation was entirely professional and a very good experience for me. It hasn't been commissioned as yet so as to retain elligibility for government rebates, but I expect no problems.I would recommend PSC to anyone who wants one company to do, and be responsible for, everything. No chance of a fly-by-night installer disappearing and customer being left with problems. A bit more expensive, because installers are all employed staff of PSC, not contractors, but worth for peace-of-mind IMO.PSC is a very established business, with a very good reputation. I'm very impressed with PSC and am more than happy to reccomend them highly.

Really great experience from start to finish.Peter from sales team took the trouble to visit the property, discuss options and generally guide us through the decision making process.Installation team led by Nathaniel were excellent, really knowledgeable, quick and a very neat installation.
From start to finish excellent to deal with very happy
Fantastic service from initial discussions to installation. Would (and have) recommend.
From initial call to installation, very easy to deal with.Installers very neat and tidyA Very professional company in all aspects
Some good advice, very helpful when quoting. The installers were pleasant and tidyed up nicely

We are very happy with the whole process, from the initial phone enquiry, to the quote and then to the installation, it all went very smoothly.It was stressful for me as I knew very little about solar and I spent a lot of time on the Solar Quotes web site.It was a steep learning curve. but the installers recommended to us by Solar Quotes were all very good at explaining the various combinations of systems available and what would suit us.We went with what we considered the best of a good bunch and chose to use Penrith Solar Center (now PSC Energy NSW).We always dealt with the same sales person, who was very helpful in answering the many questions we had and helped guide us through the process of choosing our system.Very happy with the crew who installed the system. They were all very professional and efficient at they work. They too were patient with our questions on the day.

Joel  from Penrith Solar came to my home to discuss where the best location was for the battery because there was no room to piggyback it onto my first Tesla Powerwall 2 battery that is on a external wall.   Second Battery was installed on another external wall.No problems with date for installation, paperwork and adding second battery onto the Tesla App.They installed the second Tesla Powerwall 2 battery one day ago.Installation went smoothly and professionally.    All done in about 4 hours and they left the area tidy.Next day both batteries 100% charged by 5pm with a 5.7kW solar system.So far so good.Another company SQ recommended responded promptly and were very professional. They were more expensive than Penrith Solar.I arranged quotes from other installers on the SolarQuotes website that responded quickly and professionally but they were all priced higher than Penrith Solar Centre.I have had no problems with my first Tesla Powerwall 2 battery installed in May 2022.   Elon forced my hand to install a second Powerwall 2 battery earlier than I would have liked because the new Powerwall 3 is not compatible with the Powerwall 2.Not happy that I was not eligible for  the government battery rebate because it is my second battery despite the fact that I did not receive any rebate for the first battery.

Decided on a local supplier that I know will get the support I need if required, went into the store and the sales consultant Hiren was more than willing to answer all my concerns and questions as I had a lot because I did the research, showed us all around the warehouse and their training facility as well as example of the panels and fittings , spent more than I originally wanted but happy to go with micro inverters over the string11.7kwInstallation team were great, polite, friendly, happy to answer questions and let us know what they were doing and led by Aaron, connected to grid straight away and system was up and running straight away just had to wait a few days for connection to the app from enphase .So far so good happy with the service .

I spoke to 5 different companies but Penrith Solar by far, was the most professional and customer friendly company I dealt.From the outset, Penrith Solar were the most proactive. They offered up more information and detail than I asked for and made the whole process easy and comfortable to deal with.The installation team were fantastic. They were polite to deal with and despite my incessant questioning, were easy going and extremely professional. On completion, the installation was clean and tidy and with minimal visual impact.I would definitely recommend Penrith Solar!!!

Penrith Solar Centre (PSC) installed 26 Trina 455W solar panels, with Enphase microinverters and a Tesla Powerwall 3.PSC were quick to make initial contact to understand my requirements. The sales rep was always polite while I asked many questions so I could fully understand the solar and battery system suitable for my use case. Their wealth of knowledge from the staff, their website and the YouTube videos made by PSC, were all very reassuring.The installation team was prompt and polite. They had to make a number of part day visits due to the patchy rain, but they always communicated clearly when they would return and they still managed to finish very quickly. The installers showed me everything I needed to know for safety and shutdown procedures, as well as setting up the Tesla app and running through what everything means.I didn’t consider any other installers because PSC provided answered all my questions patiently, never pushing for a sale. Their YouTube videos actually won me over by demonstrating a number of installs. The other reviews were consistently good and I highly recommend Penrith Solar Centre as well.

I was really impressed with the support provided by Penrith Solar from initial discussions about the system that met my requirements and my house right through to the installation process. They walked me through the installation process and what to expectAnd then looked after all the electricity company paper work for feed in tariffs etc.The system they recommended is doing exactly as they said it would and I’m really happy. I wouldn’t hesitate in recommending Penrith Solar

Very impressed with the professionalism of PSC. All queries were answered promptly and with great detail. This company was very easy to deal with and always kept us up to date. The fact that all work was done “in-house” was a major factor in the decision to go with PSC. The whole installation was carried out very smoothly and efficiently over 2 days. The installation crew set up the app and showed us how to use it. All work areas were left clean and tidy. It’s a bit over a week since installation and we are yet to need any power from the grid. The system is working better than expected and so far there have been no issues.
Penrith Solar were great to deal with and were cheaper then the other quote received. Very happy with system and interest free loan.
Quoting & installation were timely and written instructions provided were clear. No problems with anything. All good!
I had a Tesla battery installed a week ago by their friendly team of Aaron, Brendan & Mark. The installation went well and i am very satisfied by the service and their work.
Prompt, punctual and professional, from start to finish.They organised everything from a home visit to smart meter installation.
From quote to installation Penrith Solar we’re consummate professionals with fantastic communication and advice delivering on their promise

Quoting was simple. Some additional electrical work was required to be done prior to solar installation. My electrician even commented on how good this solar company is so that was a good sign.Install was punctual and professionalCustomer service is top notch

The whole team at Penrith Solar Centre were wonderful, from our exploratory conversations at the start, through to the installation itself, and finally the post-installation handover. We were kept informed at every stage. Work on the roof was completed professionally and in a timely fashion. The on-site electricians and back-office took care of the paperwork. We are now generating electricity for our own use and the grid, monitored with a handy app. All as intended.

Found Penrith Solar Centre  to be outstanding, punctual and very professional. Their quote process was so easy and Joel was so informative and his product knowledge was outstanding, and they help with contacting our energy provider

Their customer service was very supportive through the whole process. They addressed all my concerns through out the process. They even price matched a more competitive quote for the same system.

Penrith Solar Centre was a delight to deal with, from the first contact everything went  smoothy. The sales representative, installers all arrived  on time as arranged. All connections with the grid company was arranged by the installer so there was nothing for me to do. A very  professional company who I would recommend to anyone thinking of having solar installed.
The team at Penrith Solar were honest and provided a competitive quote and installation within 5 days. Their workmanship was perfect and cleaned up after the installation.

I was extremely happy with the quoting process. Ii was clear to me as to what was going to be installed. The installation went like clockwork with no delays. I previously had solar panels installed a couple of years ago and this time I only had batteries installed. Grid connection was already available.

Great service all round from the quote, covered all the usual items i was expecting, with current aerial photos etc.inspection  seveal days before the install, covered off requestements, installation very tidy and clean install. The sales person was very knowledgeable, listened to our needs, was responsive, offered quality suggestions and provided a system that was fit for purpose. On installation day, they arrived on-time, efficient team, met milestones as stated and walked through the components at handover.Overall an really great experience with Penrith Solar and would highly recommend

I was really impressed with Penrith Solar and am really happy with our system, the only downside was it took 6 weeks to get our account setup for the Enphase app, I had to follow up with them several times, but aside from that I am really happy with the system.

Every aspect of the quote process, installation and commissioning was superb. They did a site visit prior to quoting, which I believe is very important. The estimate of solar power generated was more accurate than other companies due to their sophisticated modelling. The installers were efficient and polite. They removed my redundant pool heating spaghetti and cleaned the gutters without extra charge. Their electrician gave me clear instructions on how to use the system and I was making solar power on day 1.Highly recommended.

These guys were awesome they had to make a few changes due to my roof not allowing them to proceed as planned. They let me know the changes and discussed the changes and the best way forward. Showing the benefits of different options.Quick efficient and quality outcome

Very happy with Penrith solar centre, Shaun the salesman couldn't do enough to answer questions including shooting us a vidio to show us how the installation would go and Joel,Wade,Brad and Coby did a great  job on the installation,thumbs up

The sales/quoting  process was very good. provided diagram of the proposed placing of the panels. Visited the property and made an inspection.The installation was spot on arrived on time, very professional & tidyThe customer service was also very good. organized grid connection explained how the application worksOverall it was a very positive experience and would not hesitate to recommend Penrith Solar.
Great customer service. Install was smooth. Communication was great. So far working as expected

Sales process was good although the system is a little pricey in comparison to standard string inverter. However it is good quality and installers were very efficient. They have a good financing option, making the sales process a lot easier.One thing I’m still waiting to be resolved is my export limit adjustment, as the application done by the company had a mistake and I was assigned the 1 phase 5 kw limit export instead of the 3 phase 10-15kw. Our whole experience from sales to installation has been very good. The salesman, Sean, was very knowledgeable and able to answer questions throughly and with ease.The installation team (Aaron, Patrick, Oliver, Mark) were great on the day. They did a quiet and clean job. They were able to easily troubleshoot and fix issues such as a foxtel dish that was blocking a panel.The system and interface is user friendly.A big thanks to the knowledgeable and helpful staff at Penrith Solar Centre.

I couldn't have been happier with Penrith Solar Centre (PSC) throughout the sales, quote and installation process. It was what I expected from a top quality service provider.They lived up to their excellent reputation which became even more apparent when an unexpected event took place a few days after our new solar system was installed and running smoothly.A large gum tree on our street fell onto the power lines and the subsequent high voltage power surge into our house caused the switchboard to explode and significant damage other electrical appliances. Unfortunately this also included our brand new Enphase IQ control unit.It took 5-6 weeks to get everything repaired and running properly again - not just the solar and there was no hold up due to PSC, but throughout they were always available, supportive and responsive. I can't thank them enough and it goes to show it might cost a bit more for the best quality, but at times like this it was worth every cent.Well done to all the PSC team.

The sales process was easy and they kept in contact by email and phoneThe installers turned up on time and worked hard all day to get the system up and runningPenrith Solar were great in sending us clear information about our system and next steps in regards to our energy provider The info was easy to follow and we feel confident we understand the system

We got Trina solar panels with emphases. The sales process was good and no pushy sales.The installation went smoothly. Even with the windy weather. The installers were hard working, turned up on time, gave us regular updates and were very clean and tidy.Installation in Newcastle was not a problem for them.All the paperwork was done by penrith solar.The staff were amazing to deal with at all levels.They were more than willing to answer questions after installation.I cannot recommend them highly enough.

We did have a representative from another installer (history in hotwater systems) who quoted us constantly bag other installers and when they found we went with PSC the other company kept texting me, sometimes at 1030pm telling me I was stupid for going with Enphase iQ8HC micro inverters. I advised the PSC quote was much cheaper.

Penrith Solar gladly traveled to Kensington to complete the job. Aaron and his team demonstrated a high level of professionalism and efficiency. Notably, they went the extra mile to realign the battery mounting after noticing it wasn't flush. The cleanup afterward was greatly appreciated. I have confidence in their commitment to honoring the warranty and addressing any unforeseen issues in the future. Overall, I am highly satisfied with the job they've done.

Penrith solar were excellent from sales to install to handoverPenrith solar organised smart metre install with connection to gridOverall Penrith solar were polite ,tidy and punctual.would highly recommend them .Now we just need to pay it off ( we do this through Nectr )

The quoting process is quite exhausting (I like to read everything and tend to ask lots of questions) but is definitely worthwhile taking the time to do. I inadvertently contacted 3Quotes before SolarQuotes, so had to endure additional phone calls from unsuitable companies - SolarQuotes is far superior for this process.It was a very close decision between Penrith Solar and 1Komma5, who actually brought out an installer with their salesman for the site inspection - he was able to answer more of my questions than the salesman.The installers did a great job on a very hot day - punctual, efficient, and helpful in answering more questions. There were a few gliches we needed to work out between where the salesman had said panels could go and where they could actually be placed (i.e. not too close to guttering), but Jai was fantastic in resolving that in consultation with me on the morning of the installation. He couldn't have been more accommodating, and was able to place the additional panels on my preferred western-facing roof despite having to work around more obstacles on that side.

Charlie was great to deal with, he created a plan but still took my feedback on board and changed to suit. Mitch and his team installed to system over 2 days because of rain stoppages, but were very neat and tidy and tedious with their work.I particularly liked the black panel racking which matched my dark roof colour.

Initial conversations/Quotes with Jake, Joshua & Ellie from accounts were very pleasant & professional.They answered all my queries on the Enphase Micro Inverter System & provided comprehensive documentation.Joshua did a site visit prior to installation to confirm all was good.The installation team led by Darcy Matt Isaac & George did a fantastic install & replaced roof tiles as required.They returned two days later to make final adjustments proposed by Tech Steve to the Envoy module due to poor weather.All work was on time & punctual.They organised grid connection within 16 days.I would highly recommend Penrith Solar Centre to anyone wanting a professional competitive solar install.Regards,Gary & Mollie Richmond
Great customer service, fast to respond to any questions and very good at keeping me informed of the process.  Installation was quick and hassle free.

Quote was very detailed, we arranged for a sales person to visit and go over any queries we had. We signed on this visit and follow up from the company was prompt and efficient. They kept us informed of progress and installation was earlier than expected. They arranged grid connection which should be completed within 10 business days of installation. Overall, it went like clockwork.

The process was very smooth.  The quote was professional and clear to understand.  They were happy to answer any questions or concerns i had. The installers arrived on time on day of installation.The installation was done by the end of the day, all mess was cleaned up and checked before they left.No complaints from me.

The whole process of obtaining a quote, seeing the options and completing installation was super easy. The whole team are super friendly and answered all our questions.Really good to deal with and highly recommend them.
The process was efficient and was done on time and in a quick turn around despite the Christmas rush.

Very helpful with all the questions during the presales stage.Install date set after deposit payment, and then luckily brought forward nearly two weeks.The work was finished by lunchtime (single storey house)! And that included going back to the shop to get another panel after working out we could fit one more on the roof.Mains power was only out for ~15-30min.Set up was quick, and access to the app came within a few days.Still waiting on the electricity provider to come and swap the meters for a smart meter. I wish they were as efficient as Penrith Solar Centre.
I did like that quality control. Each person knew their job and performed very well and happy to do business with this company. Thank you

This is a review of a battery installation not a system.Today I finally got a battery to go with my solar panels, I’ve been waiting 10 years so it was a red letter day. I chose Penrith Solar Centre because of the strength of their reviews and their reputation. They were also very competitive on price which was reflected in the long waiting list, but I was happy to wait for a quality installation. It was 7 weeks after first contact that I got my PW2 and that was a month early due to someone else baling out. A couple of companies could have done an install a week after my enquiry but I thought it was better to go with the guys who were very busy, even if had to wait a fair bit longer.Darcy, Joel, George and Cooper turned up in this massive purple truck just after 7 am and got right into it. My installation had a couple of hiccups they had to sort through but they worked it out without any dramas. They worked hard to not use any conduit on the outside of the building, except a short stretch that was unavoidable. Darcy kept checking with me to make they were doing what I wanted and at the end he and Joel came up and showed me how to use the amazing Tesla app on my phone.As well as the install team I received great support from several members of the team at home base, namely Peter Duong, Charlie Connor, Josh Armstrong, Jordan, Hana and Jory McDermott the installation manager, who answered my curly questions. I also loved the phone calls and emails keeping me in the loop and preparing me for install day. I absolutely recommend Penrith Solar Centre for anything solar.

PSC did a thorough site evaluation and understood what we wanted to achieve out of the system.Competitive pricing, no hidden extras and did not take any short cuts.Installers are Professional, prompt and courteous. No mess was left behind.They did not leave till everything was tested.This is a company that you don't have to be nervous about getting a shoddy installation.They only use local employees who are all certified.

Quoting process was very informative with no surprises but do your research,waiting on installation,we have a date but don’t expect panels the next day,customer service has been fine so far apart from automated contacts from company having me think something was wrong,no problem though and I do recommend Penrith Solar for your installation.

What an incredible journey working with Penrith Solar. From the first consultation, through to the installation and handover, my experience with PSC has been exceptional. Positive purchase/installation process.Sales very informative without being pushy.The installation was 10/10:- Good communication prior to install- Installed on exact day/time promised- Excellent installers, very efficient and left the place spotless.Highly recommended

sales person came out as soon as I asked for not only a quote online but in person - discussed all my needs and listened to what I wanted , and then very quick installation ,and team were polite and efficient - only slight delay was getting ausgrid forms then for  them to be passed on to my supplier , however once connected this would then be back dated , so in the end not an issue.the ensure app is also very easy to use with daily usage including each panels output .

We received 3 good quotes from SolarQuotes but decided to go with Penrith Solar Centre has they seemed to tick all the boxes. The system was installed this week and is producing all the power as promised. The installation team was great.Happy Customer

very happy with the install by Penrith Solar Centre.One of the earlier installs of the enphase IQ8 microinverters.Enphase system is fantastic.
